project_type: Windows DLL proxy for DirectX 11 (GW2 translation overlay)
build_system: CMake + vcpkg (x64-windows-static-md triplet), MSVC compiler. Uses CMakePresets.json with 'windows-msvc' preset.
test_framework: No automated tests - manual testing only (DLL loaded by game process)
build_command: Cannot build locally - requires Windows + MSVC + vcpkg with imgui, tesseract, sqlite3, nlohmann-json, minhook. Use AST/syntax validation only.
test_command: N/A - no test suite, relies on static analysis of C++ code
verification_instructions: Verify source files compile correctly by checking includes, namespace usage, and that CMakeLists.txt references all new source files. Since this is a Windows-only DLL requiring vcpkg, full build is not possible in this sandbox.
environment_constraints: Linux sandbox - cannot build Windows DLL. Validation limited to source code correctness, consistent patterns, and CMakeLists.txt integration. No compiler available for this target.
contribution_requirements: C++20, bronco:: namespace, #pragma once, document public functions with /// comments, follow existing code style
key_patterns: Namespaces: bronco::proxy, bronco::hook, bronco::overlay, bronco::pipeline, bronco::ocr. Singleton pattern for Config and Pipeline. OutputDebugStringA for logging. Atomic operations for thread safety. MinHook for inline hooking. ImGui for overlay rendering. ocr_loader.cpp uses LoadLibrary pattern for dynamic DLL loading.
directory_structure: src/ contains all source. Sub-dirs: proxy/ (d3d11 forwarding), hook/ (MinHook Present interception), overlay/ (ImGui rendering), pipeline/ (OCR worker thread), config/ (JSON config singleton), ocr/ (dynamic loader for bronco_ocr.dll), cache/ (LRU cache template). Build output: d3d11.dll (proxy) + bronco_ocr.dll (heavy OCR engine).
